description: Water Modelling-NARCliM1.0 climate projection scaling factors is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Climate Risk Datasets: NARCliM 1. 0 Climate risk datasets derived from Global Climate Models (GCMs) typically have a coarse spatial resolution (around 100-200km grid cells), whereas water models require data with much finer spatial resolution. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are DCCEEW - Water, DCCEEW - Water Analytics, modelling, surface water. It offers 3 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
